card.name: Setup for 'few people know' contrasts
card.fires_on: The word right after a 'common knowledge' setup that turns to what few or no people know, such as 'But', 'but', 'most', 'few', 'rarely', 'no'. Also weakly on 'reported' or 'of' in label sentences about counts of patients.

modes.label: Turn to rare knowledge
modes.description: A contrast word or quantity word that leads into 'few/most people don't know or realize'.

modes.label: Negative-frequency words
modes.description: Words like rarely, scarcely, no that begin a sentence about something that seldom or never happens.

modes.label: Reported-in-patients phrasing
modes.description: The word 'reported' after an adverse event, just before a percentage of patients.
modes.example: infections were<< reported>> in 81% of patients in

card.writes: It pushes toward words meaning 'nobody' or 'no one' (in English, Chinese and Russian).
card.plain: It fires where a sentence is turning to something that hardly anyone knows or does.
